name: Quest Consciousness
vision_statement: Each Quest user grows with an AI aligned to them.
opportunities: Aligning an AI to a person is half of helping them; the other half is helping the person's own intents move, which no part of the hub's Consciousness does for them.
solution_coherence: Quest Consciousness is where the assistant adapts to the person it works for and helps them move toward their intents. Quest Requests takes in what the person asks, from every Quest surface, once. Quest Representatives gives each request to the representative that fits it. Quest Decision Requests carries a decision that only a person can make to the person it belongs to. Feedback Learning keeps what the person corrected so it guides later work. Intent Evolution then suggests the option most likely to work for the person's intents, or an experiment when the best option is not yet known.
